key_concepts: A released object falls due to gravity.
A table exerts an upward normal force on a book.
Tension in a string can support a hanging object.
Friction slows and stops a moving ball.
Air resistance affects falling paper depending on its shape.
A stretched spring exerts a restoring force.
Rubbed plastic exerts electrostatic force on paper bits.
Magnets exert noncontact magnetic force on iron.
Water exerts buoyant force on wood.
Contact forces require touching; noncontact forces act at a distance.
Weight measured by a spring scale increases with mass.
Force needed to start moving an object depends on surface roughness.
